Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the options. Quick note from procurement: we have a vendor intake policy that applies to any third-party inference or data-processing vendor. Before we schedule a live technical demo with engineers, we need the following to be completed:

- Supplier questionnaire completed in our portal (security & data handling)
- NDA executed (standard MSA addendum)
- SOC 2 summary or recent attestation (if available)

I attached the portal instructions and an intake checklist. The portal asks that the questionnaire be submitted at least 72 hours before the demo so our risk team can triage responses. Given internal calendar constraints, we're looking at rescheduling into the week of Apr 1–5.

Attachment: medicasys_vendor_portal_instructions.pdf

Procurement contact: procurement@medicasys.com — they should be on the loop for any questions about the form. Once you upload the questionnaire and return the NDA, we can confirm a firm demo slot.

Thanks,
Cara Liu
Director, Platform Partnerships
MedicaSys
cara.liu@medicasys.com
